caption: The drawing depicts a wooden canopy bed with four posts and a rectangular frame. The bed is fitted with white or light cream curtains that are draped around the canopy and tied back at each corner with ties, leaving the interior visible. The fabric has subtle vertical lines, and the curtains appear slightly gathered at the top and bottom where they are tied. The bed itself has a white pillow and a neatly made white bedspread with visible stitching and edging detail, lying atop a wooden bed frame with simple rectangular legs. The color palette consists mostly of creams and light browns, with the wood being a light to medium brown and the bedding and curtains a slightly off-white color. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored.
title: Doll Bed
